old_caption: A dancer in a flowing, pastel-colored dress performs in a dance studio with mirrored walls. She moves gracefully, extending her arms and shifting her posture, her reflection visible in the mirror. The studio has a large window, white curtains, and ballet barres, with exercise mats and equipment visible in the background. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the dancer's movements as she maintains a central position in the frame.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a dance performance set in a spacious studio with mirrored walls and a large window allowing natural light to flood the space. The dancer, dressed in a flowing, pastel-colored dress, gracefully moves across the floor, her movements fluid and expressive. She begins by extending her arms outward, then transitions into a series of elegant spins and arm gestures, showcasing her skill and poise. The studio is equipped with ballet barres and various exercise mats, indicating it is a dedicated space for dance practice or instruction. The lighting is soft yet bright, enhancing the serene atmosphere of the performance. The dancer's movements are synchronized with the music, creating a harmonious blend of motion and rhythm. Throughout the sequence, the dancer maintains a central position in the frame, drawing the viewer's focus to her graceful performance.
caption: The video captures a single female dancer in a long gradient dress—green at the bodice, pink at the waist, green at the hem—with trailing pale sleeves, standing before a full-wall mirror in a brightly lit studio. Behind the mirror's vertical seam, white pleated curtains hang beneath purple and white ceiling spotlights, while a window on the right reveals city buildings beside wooden ballet barres, stacked blue mats, red blocks, and a black speaker. The dancer's head tilts progressively backward as her arms lift and spread outward, drawing the sleeves up beside her face. She then rotates through a side profile until her back faces the camera and she confronts the mirror. Throughout, her reflection tracks each pose in sync. Her raised arms continue small undulating motions while the skirt sways gently. Her position relative to the mirror seam stays essentially fixed as only orientation and limb configuration change.
